notes.title: Enhancements arriving
notes.content:
Even after the release, we are still working to guarantee the best possible game experience to you.

Here are some of the changes that we just released:

[olist]
[*] We switched the buttons to Confirm and Cancel on menus. The "south" controller button ("A" for XBOX, "X" for PS, "B" for Nintendo) will be used to Confirm, and the "east" controller button ("B" for XBOX, "O" for PS, "A" for Nintendo) will be used to Cancel/Back. This will put the game on track with the majority of other titles.
[*] Fixes on map design.
[*] Animation enhancements.
[*] It's possible to accelerate the game opening scene (the logo exhibition) by pressing the "south" controller button.
[*] Items will be shown rotated during placement selection, automatically pointing to a wall and giving precedence to a wire. This will allow a faster gameplay and will help avoid some misplacements. The wire will also show how it will extend and connect to the item before the final placement. [img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/ZsSDPxEud1tSrnKUj9/giphy.gif?cid=790b76110fb1d73d59cdcf2c6ff599f07749e1d421c437f1&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]
[*] It's possible to look up and down during gameplay by pressing and holding the up and down directional while standing still, this will help plan your jumps and route. [img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/o7HPOgWLK257KaLHYq/giphy.gif?cid=790b76114e53fca897f0747f756ac3dffb83f45166aaef45&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]
[/olist]

We hope you are enjoying the game.

See you soon!
